location: Kong Lor Cave, Phu Hin Bun National Park, Khammouane
alt: The entrance of Kong Lor Cave with the river flowing into the limestone mountain
caption: Kong Lor Cave, where the Nam Hin Bun river runs 7.5 km through a limestone mountain in Phu Hin Bun National Park. Day 5 is the heart of the trip: a longtail boat takes four travellers through the dark.

alt: Dark river chamber inside Kong Lor Cave lit by lamps
caption: Inside Kong Lor Cave, the river passage is lit only by headlamps and the boatman's torch. On Day 5 the water is low enough in February that passengers step out and walk across sandbanks between boat sections.

alt: The Kong Lor cave mouth beneath forested karst limestone cliffs
caption: The river mouth of Kong Lor Cave framed by Phu Hin Bun karst towers. It is the landscape of Day 4, when the van climbs from the Mekong at Thakhek and the group reaches the village before the cave.

commonsFile: File:Temple Wat Xieng Thong - Luang Prabang - Laos.jpg
alt: Sweeping tiered roofs and mosaic walls of Wat Xieng Thong in Luang Prabang
caption: Wat Xieng Thong, Luang Prabang's royal temple, with its sweeping roofs and gilded mosaics, dates from the 16th century. The group walks to it from the old town on Day 8 after the Laos-China railway arrives.

commonsFile: File:Buddhist monks cleaning the yard at Wat Xieng Thong temple.jpg
alt: Saffron-robed monks sweeping the yard at Wat Xieng Thong temple
caption: Monks sweeping the courtyard of Wat Xieng Thong, part of the daily temple routine visible to visitors. Day 9 begins with the dawn alms round in Luang Prabang, and this is the same quiet temple life seen from inside.

commonsFile: File:Muang Ngoi Neua from the Phanoi Viewpoint.jpg
location: Muang Ngoi Neua, Nam Ou valley
alt: Roofs of Muang Ngoi Neua beside the broad Nam Ou river among forested hills, seen from a viewpoint
caption: Muang Ngoi Neua and the Nam Ou seen from the Phanoi viewpoint, a short climb above the village that has no road. Photographed in the rainy season; in February the river is much lower and clearer. This is the Day 10 destination.

commonsFile: File:Main street in Muang Ngoi Neua.jpg
alt: The main street of Muang Ngoi Neua with wooden guesthouses and no vehicles
caption: The unpaved main street of Muang Ngoi Neua, lined with guesthouses and small restaurants, is where Days 10-11 are spent. There are no cars: the village is reached only by boat along the Nam Ou.

commonsFile: File:Train Station Luang Prabang - Laos China Railway.jpg
alt: The modern Luang Prabang railway station building of the Laos-China railway
caption: Luang Prabang station on the Laos-China railway, which replaces a full day on the road between Vientiane and the north. On Day 8 the group takes the train here to reach the temple town.

alt: The golden stupa of Pha That Luang in Vientiane
caption: Pha That Luang, the gilded stupa that is Laos's national symbol, in Vientiane. The group sees it on Day 2 after arriving on the Mekong, before heading south by van.

commonsFile: File:Kuang Si Falls and its turquoise tiered water pools in Luang Prabang province Laos.jpg
location: Kuang Si Falls, Luang Prabang province
alt: Tiered turquoise pools of Kuang Si Falls surrounded by forest
caption: The tiered turquoise pools of Kuang Si Falls, about 30 km from Luang Prabang. Day 9 visits them after the dawn alms, with time to walk to the upper falls and swim in cooler water.

alt: Line of saffron-robed monks receiving alms at dawn in Luang Prabang
caption: Monks receive sticky rice at dawn along the streets of Luang Prabang. It is the first activity of Day 9; visitors are asked to watch quietly and from a respectful distance.

alt: The Nam Ou river at Nong Khiaw beneath steep limestone peaks
caption: The Nam Ou at Nong Khiaw, squeezed between limestone peaks. This is where the minivan from Luang Prabang ends on Day 10, before the boat continues upriver to Muang Ngoi Neua.

commonsFile: File:Mount Phou Si from the Mekong.jpg
location: Mount Phou Si and the Mekong, Luang Prabang
alt: Mount Phou Si rising above the bank of the Mekong in Luang Prabang
caption: Mount Phou Si rises beside the Mekong in the middle of Luang Prabang's old town. A short stair climb gives the best view over the temples, rivers and old town on the afternoon of Day 8.

alt: The Mekong riverfront at Thakhek with the Thai bank beyond
caption: The Mekong at Thakhek, with Thailand on the far bank. This is the base for Days 3-4 before the van climbs into the Phu Hin Bun limestone towards Kong Lor.

location: Nam Ou river, Luang Prabang province
alt: A narrow longtail passenger boat on the Nam Ou river
caption: A long passenger boat on the Nam Ou. On Days 10-12 the river is the only road between Nong Khiaw, Muang Ngoi Neua and back, and the boat ride is as much of the trip as the destinations.
